items.title: the hover on a TRAIT named in a parameter's type position - `Signal` in `fun login_block(username: Signal<str>, password: Signal<str>)` (kolt login_page.vl:72:50) - is upgraded past E240's required-members block: the trait's head and where it lives, its `///`, the required members at the written arguments (E240's), and WHAT CAN BE PASSED HERE - the implementors in reach (`SignalCell<str>`, `ProxySignal<str>`, a `derive`d source, …), the question a reader at a parameter position is asking
items.discussion: the owner's ask (2026-10-12/13): "upgrade the tooltip at login_page.vl:72:50" - the `Signal` of `password: Signal<str>`; E240 (a trait in a bound or a `with` clause hovers with its required members at the arguments written, then its `///` - `Document::reference_hover` over `Program::reference_hovers`; pin `e240_a_trait_in_a_bound_or_a_with_clause_hovers_with_its_required_members`: `trait Read<U> { fun read(self): U; }`); E237 (a trait-typed parameter's VALUE hovers with the required members as its definition block - the parameter NAME's answer; this item is the TYPE's); E238/E299 (the owner line / the `mod` line above a fence); E227 Q5 (`[hint]` abbreviations: `~Source<..>` - a trait used as an abbreviation host); E298 (the module hover's "Exports" preview - the same capped-list rendering); std's `trait Signal<T>` (reactive), implemented by `SignalCell<T>`, `ProxySignal<T>` (kolt's own, `impl ProxySignal<T> with Signal<T>`), …
items.body: Recommended shape, for the owner to confirm or amend: one fenced `vilan` block - `mod std::reactive` (E299's line), then `trait Signal<T>` with its supertraits (`trait Signal<T> with Source<T>`), then E240's required members at the written arguments (`fun get(self): str;` …) - then the Doc block (the trait's `///`), then a Preview line "Implemented by `SignalCell<str>`, `ProxySignal<str>`, `Memo<str>`, … (N in reach)" - the impls the calling file REACHES (B318's import surface, as B598 answers a call), capped at a dozen with "and N more", generic impls shown at the written argument - and, where the trait is a `[hint]` host, the note E227 writes. A trait with no `///` and no reachable impl keeps E240's answer. The same block answers a trait in a bound (`fun f<S: Signal<str>>`) and in a `with` clause; a STRUCT in type position is unchanged (its declaration already answers). Cost: the implementor list is the impl table filtered by trait id and reach, computed at hover time (one hover, not per keystroke); the hover row of lsp-latency must not move. Pins: the kolt shape (a std trait at a written argument, two kolt impls in reach), a user trait with one impl, a trait with no impl, a bound position, a `with` clause (E240's pins stand), a `[hint]` host, a generic impl substituted. Sizing S (vilan-lsp document.rs `reference_hover` + an implementors query over `program.implementations` by reach).
